notes.title: Many Modes Update
notes.content:
This update adds a few new game modes to Guildmaster;
[list]
[*][b]The Golem's Challenge[/b]
A mysterious golem challenges the heroes to fight through randomly generated dungeons. The heroes will reach power levels beyond those in the main campaign, and encounter a few new enemy types.
[*][b]Survival Mode[/b]
Fight against endless waves of enemies with four heroes equipped from the most powerful items in the game and see how long you can survive. Compete with other players in the leaderboards!
[*][b]Story Mode[/b]
A new difficulty mode for the main campaign. Heroes will no longer be returned to the guild when they are defeated. Instead they will be knocked out for one turn. Now players of all skill levels can see Guildmaster through to the end.
[*][b]Chatty Mode[/b]
Experience all of the dialogue interactions between the Guildmaster and the heroes with this mode, in which heroes will give their dialogue for the previous quest, whether they went on it or not.
[/list]
